_doc: S1.2–S1.4 — UN-WALK, the Starter Kit's programme (ERA1_LOGIC_v1 §3). Register: operable (perpetrator self-presentation; period-real, satire only where it collapses). ⚑ REBUILT 2026-09-20 (S151, R3-15/16/19/21/22/24): the booklet is now a Win95 WIZARD — his reference `References images/for the Era-1 programs.png`: a picture panel on the left, a bold title, plain text, Back / Next / Cancel — and its First Steps page is THE ERA'S PROGRAMME: five steps, each a press that opens its own panel and ticks off when done, in order (read · pray · connect · form · journal). The prayer step shows the sung words from `s1_prayer.json`, highlighted as they are sung, and asks for one press at the end. The connect step is the Internet Setup Wizard (`to enter online.png`, `for IRC connection.png`) on the black screen. Names follow the 'uncanny CT branding' doctrine (SCRIPT_UPDATE_v0.8 §5): TriedPath Fellowship, Un-Walk — read real, land wrong. Period vocabulary: 'struggler', 'SSA', 'change is possible'. BACK is drawn dead on every page (R26: the path only runs forward). All wording Claude's, his edit wins.

welcome.title: Welcome to Un-Walk!
lines: This programme will walk you through your
first steps out of the struggle, one at a time.
Someone who loves you wanted you to have it.
Thousands have walked this road before you.
To begin, click Next.

steps.title: Your first steps
steps.intro: Take them in order; each ticks off when done.

items.label: Pray
items.desc: The companion tape — a prayer for the journey

steps.allDone: Every step is complete. Walk on.

pages.title: Naming the struggle
lines: What you have been feeling has a name:
same-sex attraction (SSA).
It is a feeling. It is not who you are.
The world will tell you it is an identity.
We gently say: it is a struggle — and a
struggle can be walked out of, step by step.

pages.title: How the walk works
lines: You will not walk alone. A companion tape
gives you the words. A fellowship channel
gives you friends of the right kind.
A mentor will find you there. He has been
where you are. Later he will send a form
for your family, and ask for a journal.
Change is possible. Click Done to begin.

pray.title: A prayer for the journey
before: The companion tape is on the shelf beside you.
Play it here, or press the tape itself.
Follow the words as they are sung.
pray.playing: The tape is playing. Follow the words.
pray.stopped: The tape stopped before the end.
pray.ended: The prayer is over. Say it with us.

connect.title: You are not alone
lines: Right now — tonight — there are others awake,
walking it out, on the computer in front of you.
Our fellowship hosts a support channel:
#stillstruggling
A mentor will find you there. His name is Rob.

form.title: Family Form
lines: Your mentor has sent a form for your family.
It is on the desktop. Open it and answer
every question as fully as you can.

diary.title: Journal
lines: A first entry is required before your
placement. DIARY.TXT is on the desktop.

setup._doc: R3-24 — the Internet Setup Wizard on the black screen (his references: `to enter online.png`, `for IRC connection.png`). Three pages: welcome, the number, connecting. The dial-up sound plays as the connecting page opens; the channel opens when it ends.

welcome.title: Welcome to Internet Setup!
lines: This Wizard will set up your computer to
connect to the fellowship network, giving
you access to people who understand.
Your companion disk has filled in the
details. Click Next to continue.

number.title: Make New Connection
number.prompt: Type the phone number for the computer you want to call:

connecting.title: Connect To
lines: Verifying user name and password ...
Logging on to network ...
Connected at 28800 bps
